arxiv-2107-02094.title: Cosmic Ray Small Scale Anisotropies in Slab Turbulence
arxiv-2107-02094.creator: Vo Hong Minh Phan
arxiv-2107-02094.description: Abstract In the standard picture of cosmic ray transport the propagation of charged cosmic rays through turbulent magnetic fields is described as a random walk with cosmic rays scattering on magnetic field turbulence. This is in good agreement with the highly isotropic cosmic ray arrival directions as this diffusion process effectively isotropizes the cosmic ray distribution.

arxiv-2110-12442.title: Bangla Image Caption Generation through CNN-Transformer based Encoder-Decoder Network
arxiv-2110-12442.creator: Md Aminul Haque Palash, MD Abdullah Al Nasim, Sourav Saha, Faria Afrin, Raisa Mallik, Sathishkumar Samiappan
arxiv-2110-12442.description: Abstract Automatic Image Captioning is the never-ending effort of creating syntactically and validating the accuracy of textual descriptions of an image in natural language with context. The encoder-decoder structure used throughout existing Bengali Image Captioning (BIC) research utilized abstract image feature vectors as the encoder’s input.

arxiv-2208-02973.title: An Efficient Person Clustering Algorithm for Open Checkout-free Groceries
arxiv-2208-02973.creator: Junde Wu* ,†, Yu Zhang*, Rao Fu, Yuanpei Liu, Jing Gao, * equal technical contribution † project lead
arxiv-2208-02973.description: Abstract Open checkout-free grocery is the grocery store where the customers never have to wait in line to check out. Developing a system like this is not trivial since it faces challenges of recognizing the dynamic and massive flow of people.

arxiv-2211-13542.title: A Privacy-Preserving Outsourced Data Model in Cloud Environment
arxiv-2211-13542.creator: Rishabh Gupta, Ashutosh Kumar Singh
arxiv-2211-13542.description: Abstract Nowadays, more and more machine learning applications, such as medical diagnosis, online fraud detection, email spam filtering, etc., services are provided by cloud computing. The cloud service provider collects the data from the various owners to train or classify the machine learning system in the cloud environment.

arxiv-2301-02054.title: Positivity problem of three-term recurrence sequences Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2301-02054.creator: Yanni Pei, Yaling Wang, Yi Wang
arxiv-2301-02054.description: Abstract We present some necessary and/or sufficient conditions for the positivity problem of three-term recurrence sequences. As applications we show the positivity of diagonal Taylor coefficients of some rational functions in a unified approach. We also establish a criterion for the positivity and log-convexity of such sequences.

arxiv-2304-11477.title: LLM+P : Empowering Large Language Models with Optimal Planning Proficiency
arxiv-2304-11477.creator: Bo Liu, Yuqian Jiang, Xiaohan Zhang, Qiang Liu, Shiqi Zhang, Joydeep Biswas, Peter Stone
arxiv-2304-11477.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Bo Liu, Yuqian Jiang, Xiaohan Zhang, Qiang Liu, Shiqi Zhang, Joydeep Biswas, Peter Stone. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalization abilities: state-of-the-art chatbots can provide plausible answers to many common questions that arise in daily life. However, so far, LLMs cannot reliably solve long-horizon robot planning problems. By contrast, classical planners, once a problem is given in a formatted way, can use efficient search algorithms to quickly identify correct, or even optimal, plans.

arxiv-2309-07839.title: Interplay between Higgs inflation and dark matter models with dark 𝑼 ⁡ ( 𝟏 ) U(1) gauge symmetry
arxiv-2309-07839.creator: Sarif Khan, Jinsu Kim, and Pyungwon Ko
arxiv-2309-07839.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sarif Khan, Jinsu Kim, and Pyungwon Ko. We investigate dark matter phenomenology and Higgs inflation in a dark U ​ ( 1 ) D U(1)_{D} -extended model. The model features two dark matter candidates, a dark fermion and a dark vector boson. When the fermion dark matter ψ \psi is heavier than the vector dark matter W D W_{D} , there is an ample parameter space where ψ \psi is dominant over W D W_{D} .

arxiv-2402-17302.title: Can LLM Generate Culturally Relevant Commonsense QA Data? Case Study in Indonesian and Sundanese
arxiv-2402-17302.creator: Rifki Afina Putri, Faiz Ghifari Haznitrama, Dea Adhista, Alice Oh
arxiv-2402-17302.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate synthetic data for training and evaluating models. However, it is unclear whether they can generate a good quality of question answering (QA) dataset that incorporates knowledge and cultural nuance embedded in a language, especially for low-resource languages.

pmc-10714366.title: Arthroscopic Rotator Cuff Repair With Superior Fulcrum Reconstruction Using Autologous Ipsilateral Peroneus Longus Tendon for Irreparable Massive Rotator Cuff Tears
pmc-10714366.creator: Hongyan Li, Guang Chen, Run Fang, Daobin Zhou, Kehao Wang, Chen Peng, Rende Ning
pmc-10714366.description: Rotator cuff tears are still among the serious challenges encountered by sports medicine surgeons. With the development of arthroscopic technology, the treatment options for irreparable massive rotator cuff tears (IMRCTs) have gradually increased, but postoperatively, these options are prone to graft retears, reoperations, infections, revision surgical procedures, and so on.

pmc-11492081.title: Verteporfin is an effective inhibitor of HCMV replication
pmc-11492081.creator: Woo Young Lim, Ju Hyun Lee, Youngju Choi, Keejung Yoon
pmc-11492081.description: Highlights•HCMV poses significant risks to newborns and immunocompromised individuals.•Verteporfin is an FDA-approved medication used in photodynamic therapy.•Verteporfin inhibits HCMV progeny virus production.•Verteporfin suppresses HCMV gene expression from the immediate-early stages.•Verteporfin has the potential to be repurposed as a drug against HCMV infection.

pmc-12677632.title: Honeysuckle‐Derived Nanovesicles Regulate Gut Microbiota for the Treatment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-12677632.creator: Yuanyuan Wang, Yuanhao Zhou, Qingyuan Wu, Yishu Li, Yilin Huang, Kexin Yu, Ping Li, Zhenye Lv, Haotian Liu, Hai Zou, Huiyu Liu, Xiaozhou Mou
pmc-12677632.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which includes ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease, significantly impairs patients’ quality of life and is characterized by a compromised intestinal barrier, pathogenic bacterial colonization, and chronic inflammation. The gut microbiota has emerged as a therapeutic target for IBD owing to its role in modulating immune responses, metabolic pathways, and barrier function.

pmc-12711918.title: Cell line-matched reference enables high-precision functional genomics
pmc-12711918.creator: Luca Corda, Emilia Volpe, Hamza Dallali, Elena Di Tommaso, Alessio Colantoni, Andrea Guarracino, Sai Swaroop Chittoor, Mattia Capulli, Evelyne Tassone, Simona Giunta
pmc-12711918.description: Comparative analyses of newly available human genome assemblies highlight extensive variation that peaks at centromeres. Reliance on a single generic reference genome can thus hinder whole-genome analysis of sequencing data derived from laboratory cell lines and limit their accurate genomic manipulation.

pmc-12751811.title: Anesthetic management of giant thyroid tumor with cardiac comorbidity causing tracheal compression: a case report
pmc-12751811.creator: Haikun Zhang, Jinxiang Yu, Chengcheng Chen, Le Cao, Pengcheng Ma, Lifeng Jia, Nianliang Zhang, Tao Zhao
pmc-12751811.description: BackgroundThis case report described the entire process of a 72-year-old Chinese woman undergoing resection of a giant thyroid tumor. The novelty of this case report lies in its emphasis on the crucial role of anesthetic management for giant thyroid tumors, particularly in patients with concurrent cardiac comorbidities.

pmc-13039321.title: Identification of plasma biomarkers in lipid metabolism for accurate prediction of Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-13039321.creator: Xiaohui Luo, Longhao Jia, Jixin Cao, Qihao Guo, the ZIB Consortium, Jingqi Chen, Xing-Ming Zhao
pmc-13039321.description: Metabolomics may reveal non-invasive biomarkers for early diagnosis in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and provide new insights into the disease mechanisms to develop effective treatments. Here, we comprehensively analyzed the blood plasma metabolomes from a Chinese cohort of 447 individuals, including 188 AD, 181 MCI (mild cognitive impairment), and 78 NC (normal control).

pmc-13119669.title: Enhancing Stability of Reprocessed Acrylonitrile–Butadiene–Styrene (ABS) Polymers from Sorted WEEE Streams for Filament Extrusion
pmc-13119669.creator: Christina Podara, Christos Panagiotopoulos, Dionysia Kouranou, Christos Tsirogiannis, Melpo Karamitrou, Tatjana Kosanovic Milickovic, Stamatina Vouyiouka, Costas Charitidis
pmc-13119669.description: The mechanical recycling of styrenic polymers from waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) is often limited by thermomechanical degradation occurring during repeated processing. In this work, the degradation behaviour of acrylonitrile–butadiene–styrene (ABS) recovered from sorted WEEE streams was systematically investigated through multiple extrusion cycles, and the effectiveness of antioxidant stabilization was evaluated.

pmc-13275244.title: Editorial: Advances in generative artificial intelligence for mental health
pmc-13275244.creator: Nuo Han, Zengda Guan, Ang Li, Xiaoqian Liu, Xingyun Liu, Jia Xue
pmc-13275244.description: and context-sensitive recommendations (1). This generative capacity creates new possibilities for mental health assessment, intervention, training, supervision, and service delivery (2). At the same time, it raises urgent questions about safety, reliability, clinical accountability, regulation, and the appropriate boundaries between human and machine roles in mental healthcare (3, 4).

pmc-13463825.title: Global genomic surveillance of Salmonella in the environment: assessing virulence and antimicrobial resistance at scale
pmc-13463825.creator: Viraj Bandsode, Shamsul Qumar, Anuradha Singh, Debaleena Das, Humera Quadriya, Mahanga Nyambero, Vikas Gawai, Ayan Mahapatra, Torsten Semmler, Pittu Sandhya Rani, Niyaz Ahmed

pmc-13558572.title: Effects of transfer learning on seedling detection from drone imagery: a layer freezing study with faster R-CNN
pmc-13558572.creator: Hyungsik Jeong, Joungwon You, Dayoung Kim, Peter Sang-Hoon Lee, Hee Han
pmc-13558572.description: Effective decision-making in forest management relies on accurate and timely data, yet conventional manpower-based methods often fail to provide sufficient coverage. This study develops a cost-effective, deep learning–based monitoring technique for assessing replanted areas following timber harvesting, utilizing a small, field-verified dataset.

pmc-13600042.title: An Intelligent Directionality System for Hearing Aids Incorporating Deep Neural Networks: Improving Speech Understanding While Preserving Spatial Awareness
pmc-13600042.creator: Daniel Marquardt, Jinjun Xiao, Al Ganeshkumar, Jingjing Xu, Larissa Taylor, Martin McKinney, David A. Fabry, Achintya K. Bhowmik
pmc-13600042.description: Background: Directionality algorithms are fundamental to modern hearing aids, enhancing speech perception in noisy environments by improving the signal-to-noise ratio. Conventional adaptive approaches rely on heuristic optimization criteria and often improve speech understanding from specific directions, typically the front, at the expense of spatial awareness.
